title: Tianna / Tiana Bay and Creek
summary: Tianna is a bay and creek name at Good Ground, now Hampton Bays, in western Southampton.
history_content: The name appears in a 1738 Quogue purchase division that used Tiannah water as a boundary. Local tradition connects the name with a Native woman named Tianah who lived near the head of the bay.
translation_content:
Recorded forms include Tiannah, Tyana, Tianah, Tiana, and Tianna. The name is treated as a personal-name placename rather than a securely translated landscape term.

Why Place Names Matter

“The specific information about the land encoded within place names is crucial for travellers.”

— Aliana Violet Parker, Learning the Language of the Land: A Review and Analysis of U.S. Federal Policy on Native American Sacred Places (2012), Printed p. 30
preservation_content: Tianna keeps a personal name attached to the Hampton Bays water landscape, linking bay, creek, and boundary records in Shinnecock homelands.
